verdict.rationale: Jev is API-first. The Playground's core workflow (paste state, add Choice/Score/Noul questions) maps directly onto the documented API and SDKs, which also expose model listing via GET /v1/models. However, no doc claims full UI/API parity, and console functions such as account, key or billing management have no documented API equivalent; the OpenAPI probe also returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit UI-API parity statement, API coverage of console/account/key management, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
